purpose: Checksum manifest for the internal Phase 3/4 planning documents in docs/, which are intentionally excluded from git version control by .gitignore's '# internal (not for public repo)' policy. This file is tracked so the reproducibility/audit trail records that these documents existed, in this exact state, at this commit -- without reversing the repo's own decision to keep full planning prose out of the public history.

anchor_commit.message: docs: freeze phase3 evidence and phase4 scientific spine

policy_statement: docs/ is intentionally outside git version control per .gitignore's 'internal, not for public repo' policy (a pre-existing repo decision, not something changed by this manifest). The six SHA256 hashes above let anyone with local filesystem access verify their planning documents are byte-identical to the state that existed at the anchor commit above, without those documents themselves ever entering git history. If a hash here does not match a locally recomputed 'Get-FileHash <path> -Algorithm SHA256', the document has been edited since this manifest was generated.
